subject: general
question: HTTP stands for _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**HyperText Transfer Protocol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• HTTP stands for **HyperText Transfer Protocol**__.
 
• The Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) is an **application layer protocol** in the Internet protocol suite model for **distributed, collaborative, hypermedia information systems.**
 
• **HTTP **is the foundation of data communication for the **World Wide Web**, where **hypertext** documents include **hyperlinks** to other resources that the user can easily access, for example by a mouse click or by tapping the screen in a web browser.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Some important protocols**:

 
 
• SMTP - Simple Mail Transfer Protocol.
 
• FTP - File Transfer Protocol.
 
• TCP - Transmission Control Protocol
 
• UDP - User Datagram Protocol
 
• OSI - Open Systems Interconnection.
